verdict.rationale: Nothing in the evidence documents a bulk-operation capability, such as editing, archiving or updating many flags or resources in one action. The CLI and MCP server manage flags and other resources, but that is per-resource management a user could script around, not a documented bulk feature. Segments and targeting rules address many contexts within a single flag, which is a different capability, so the evidence only reaches adjacent support.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can perform bulk operations across many items at once
